basis: The chart shows the 2012 population for 0-19 years (blue line) and 20-39 years (red line). The 2012 population for 0-19 years is 89254, while for 20-39 years it is 92207. Since 92207 > 89254, the 20-39 years cohort has the larger 2012 population. The public task requires opening the follow-up record for the cohort with the larger 2012 population.
option_label: Open 2012 20-39 years demographic planning follow-up record
